channel.title: The GW Hatchet - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The GW Hatchet (gwhatchet.com)

item.title: Artist confronts family history, Japanese Internment through art
item.description: In partnership with the National Gallery of Art and For Freedoms, visual artist Marina Berio presented her self-published work, “Ten Photography Lessons for a Dead President," and discussed the themes alongside author-advocate Shirley Ann Higuchi.

item.title: GW researchers find certain weight loss drugs may increase risk of hair loss
item.description: Researchers analyzed nearly 550,000 patients and found GLP-1 use was associated with an increased risk of non-scarring hair loss.

item.title: Journalist talks Taiwan’s complex history, media coverage gaps
item.description: Chris Horton, a freelance journalist who has lived in Taiwan for ten years, discussed his new book “Ghost Nation,” which provides a comprehensive account of Taiwanese history and how journalists' portrayals of the island can harm its perceptions on a global stage.

item.title: Former US ambassador reflects on career in Middle East diplomacy
item.description: James Jeffery, a former ambassador who served under three presidents, discussed U.S. foreign policy in the Middle East and the shifting balance between diplomacy and the military at the Elliott School of International Affairs Wednesday.

item.title: Students raise campus accessibility concerns at SGA town hall
item.description: Students voiced concerns about accessibility compliance and new accessible buildings on GW campuses to a panel of GW officials at a town hall meeting Tuesday.

item.title: SBA weighs joint resolution with SGA calling on officials to bar ICE from campus events
item.description: The Student Bar Association is considering a joint resolution with the Student Government Association calling on GW to ban Immigration and Customs Enforcement from career fairs, which both bodies could pass next week.

item.title: Community members hand-deliver open letter to provost demanding GW halt GSEHD cuts
item.description: Roughly two dozen demonstrators rallied outside University President Ellen Granberg’s house Wednesday, urging administrators to reverse planned faculty layoffs and stop restructuring in the Graduate School of Education and Human Development.

item.title: Granberg announces GW will develop multiyear plan to strengthen financial health
item.description: University President Ellen Granberg announced the development of a new multiyear plan to eliminate GW's structural deficit as a part of GW's strategic framework in a community-wide email Tuesday.

item.title: Officials near deal with UHS to end GW’s financial support of MFA, Granberg says
item.description: Granberg also said School of Medicine and Health Sciences Dean and former MFA CEO Barbara Bass, who is set to retire Saturday, is not on the negotiating team with UHS but serves in a similar advisory role.

item.title: Law students elect Fernandez to SBA presidency
item.description: GW Law students elected second-year law student Juliana Fernandez, an SBA senator for the last two years and current SBA President Amanda Hichez’s chief of staff, as the next president of the Student Bar Association on Wednesday.
